source.limitations: Transcribed from Greene County Public Health Septage Haulers PDF (Registered Septage Haulers.pdf; footer 07/28/2026 on both pages; Page 2 prints 12 TOTAL), linked as Registered Sewage Haulers from the On-site Sewage Systems page (https://www.greenecophoh.gov/environmental-health/private-sewer-systems). Publisher block on the PDF: 360 WILSON DRIVE, XENIA, OH 45385-1810, Phone 1-937-374-5661, Fax 1-937-374-5675. RICOH IM C7010 scan (CreationDate 2026-07-28 18:35:11 UTC, 2 pages, page rotation 270); pdftotext extracts no text. The archived .txt is a manual transcription checked against the official PDF. Spellings kept as printed, including two separate Blue Ox rows (BLUE OX PORTABLE SERVICES, LLC with operator JARRETT TEST/WHITNEY MOORE, and BLUE OX SEPTIC SERVICES with operator JARRETT TEST), JOHNS RELIABLE SEPTIC with no apostrophe, C T BROWN SANITATION with spaces, and TRENTEL'S PORTABLES with the apostrophe. Street and city lines are joined with a space as printed. No local registration numbers on this PDF. ODH statewide bond status is not on this PDF (marked unknown). Registered Installers and Registered Service Providers PDFs on the parent page were not transcribed and were not merged. The ODH statewide septage-hauler bond list was not merged. A septage hauler registration is not a service-provider inspection credential. Appearance is not an endorsement. Verify with Greene County Public Health and ODH before you hire.
